name: Mosaic Life Care
note: Chiefs training-camp practice-jersey sponsor (Sports Business Journal, 2026-09-10: logo on the jersey since 2013; signed with the team in 2010 as Heartland Health). Physician-led health care system serving 35 counties in northwest Missouri, northeast Kansas, southeast Nebraska and southwest Iowa (mymlc.com About page, read via the Wayback Machine). Ownership not established: no primary document on the corporate structure was found; the Mosaic Life Care Foundation FAQ (mlcfoundation.com) references Mosaic Health System and the Foundation's own 501(c)(3) status but does not state who owns Mosaic Life Care. An IRS Form 990 or Missouri filing would settle it.
